question: In the factor-base log precompute, does solving full_rank + ceil(f*columns) relations (f in 0.1, 0.25, 0.5), with the filter purge spending the surplus, lower total cost (collection + linear algebra) against solving at full rank (f = 0)?

claims.text: Some f > 0 lowers the paired total counted cost C = trials + lambda*row_ops versus f = 0 on the tested cells, with the sign holding at lambda in {lambda_hat/10, lambda_hat, 10*lambda_hat}.
claims.if_supported: oversampling by f is a measured improvement of the precompute on these cells, pending the validation gate
claims.if_not_supported: no net saving from oversampling on these cells; not a claim about cells with large Krylov cores

hypotheses.statement: Some f > 0 has paired Delta C < 0 (95% bootstrap CI below 0) at all three lambda.
hypotheses.negation: For every f > 0, Delta C >= 0 or its CI contains 0.

arms.description: Second independently timed f = 0 solve of the same prefix.
Prefix ic logs first solves (end of the batch where rank became full).

controls.aa: f0_aa vs f0: identical counted cost by construction; wall spread is the noise floor
instrument_checks: every column verified [x]G == point in every arm
collection cost monotone in f (unit test)

variable_ledger.handling: one pool per seed shared by all arms; arms are prefixes

identical in every arm within a cell (block Wiedemann, block 4, target_excess fixed); filter is CADO in C1-C3 and legacy in C4. C3 and C4 share seeds and therefore identical relation pools; C3 vs C4 is a secondary paired filter contrast, outside the decision rule
isolab-eks, one host class; wall valid only at the required isolation
batch seconds pro-rated by trial; trials exact

cells: C2 degree 37 a=0 m=3 ic-search spec
C3 degree 37 a=0 m=3 subgroup_orbits points 7400 (factor base research/logs_oversampling_20261111/fb37_subgroup_orbits_7400.json), CADO filter (exploratory)
C4 = C3 with --filter-strategy legacy (legacy-filter cell): same curve, factor base, seeds and fractions; only the filter differs
sample_size.note: 30 is provisional; fix from pilot variance at freeze

metrics.definition: Delta C(f) = C(f) - C(f0), C = collection.trials + lambda*linear_algebra.row_ops, lambda_hat = median over seeds of (la_seconds/row_ops)/(collection_seconds/trials) on f0 arms; evaluated at lambda_hat/10, lambda_hat, 10*lambda_hat and 0
filter rows/nonzeros out, core_dimension, core_nonzeros, core_dimension*core_nonzeros

measurement.command: ic oversample --degree D --curve-a A --summands M [--factor-base F] --seeds 30 --fractions 0,0.1,0.25,0.5 --aa-control --logs-arm --rows-out rows.jsonl --json

execution.route: isolab-eks (CLAUDE.md); not launched by this draft

stopping_rules: pool exhausting --max-trials invalidates that seed for every arm (reported)
decision_rule: H1 for f iff the primary 95% paired bootstrap CI is below 0 at all three lambda and the wall difference exceeds the A/A 95% range; otherwise H0 for f.

analysis_plan.multiplicity: three candidate fractions per cell, four cells; report all, Holm on the primary within each cell; lambda_hat estimated per cell

open_issues: CADO filter leaves core 0-1 at C1-C3 in smoke checks; C4 (legacy filter) added 2026-11-11 to exercise a nonzero core (smoke: core 9-10, 175-190 nonzeros). A large-core cell (hundreds of columns) remains optional
